$comment: Checked-in permissions for this repo. Written by the devteam bootstrap-workflow skill.
Loads only in a session started in this repo. A session started in a parent folder does not load it.
deny: secrets, frozen paths, destructive database commands, production data access. Deny applies in every permission mode.
ask: deploy, push and other lead-only actions. The distribute-tasks batch overlay turns each ask into a deny while seats exist.
Each shell rule in deny and ask is written twice, Bash(...) and PowerShell(...): the PowerShell tool matches PowerShell rules only.
Every lift of a deny and its restore is logged in docs/agent/permission-lifts.md.
